subject: Lighthouse annual planning kickoff — targets, scenarios, and QBR prep
messages:
From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Lighthouse annual planning kickoff — targets, scenarios, and QBR prep

Team —

Kicking off the Lighthouse annual planning thread. Goal is to set high-level revenue and cost targets, align on 3 scenario bands (base / conservative / aggressive), and lock a QBR playbook so we can run tabletop rehearsals in September. Key asks: 

- Please review the attached assumptions workbook (2027_assumptions_v1.xlsx). I captured demand, pricing levers, and a first-pass capacity plan.
- Come prepared to the planning sync with three topline targets (revenue, ARR retention, gross margin impact) and one operational risk you want prioritized.
- We need a draft QBR agenda by next Friday that maps owners to each slide. I put a stub in Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/lighthouse-assumptions-2027

Proposed timeline:
- This week: leadership review of assumptions (you and your SMEs)
- Next week: cross-functional scenario workshop (90 minutes)
- Week after: finalize targets and publish the QBR deck template

Meeting proposal: Thu 7/8 10:00–11:30 PT (90m). If that doesn't work, drop alternatives.

Attachments: 2027_assumptions_v1.xlsx (assumptions + sensitivity tabs), qbr_agenda_draft_v0.2.pdf (template)

Thanks —
Chloe Martin
Head of Strategy & Planning
Redwood Inference
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Budget Advisors <budget-advisors@finadvisors.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Lighthouse annual planning kickoff — targets, scenarios, and QBR prep

Chloe —

Thanks for the clear kickoff. I reviewed the workbook quickly; two immediate notes: 

1) The demand growth assumption on tab 'Driver B' looks optimistic relative to our trailing cohort retention. Can the model include a -250bps retention scenario?
2) We should bake in a mid-year quantization/re-quantization cost line for Dedicated (one-time uplift in H2 hardware spend).

I can join the workshop on 7/8 but prefer 7/9 08:00 PT if the rest of the team can make it. Laura — can you confirm availability? Marissa — would you own the QBR slide that covers SLOs and graceful degradation (and call out fallback policies)?

Also looping in Budget Advisors to flag any modeling blind spots.

Best,
Vivek
SVP, Product & GTM
Redwood Inference
